text: App-permission gate is wired and pushed: branch opencode/app-permission-gate, commit 219dd2a. /api/chat now holds any turn that needs an app you have not been granted ('read my last note in notes' — your L4 wording) until a plain yes; the owner's own 'open X' grants that app permanently; the app records grants and sends them every turn (app_grants) so you never ask twice. GitHub repo research through your own API is never held. Verified: Worker 792/792, flutter analyze clean, flutter test 233/233. NOT verified live — no PR yet because gh CLI is missing on my machine; the owner can open one at https://github.com/Vondada/chey-app/pull/new/opencode/app-permission-gate and merge with [worker-deploy]. Also: this machine had no Node.js; portable Node v24.20.0 is now at %LOCALAPPDATA%\nodejs-portable\ for Worker tests.
